title: Socially Responsible Data for Large Multilingual Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical analysis of linguistic imperialism, language ideologies in NLP, and the historical underrepresentation of low-resource languages, providing qualitative recommendations for socially responsible data collection.
Evaluation of how Western epistemologies and data abstraction erase cultural nuances and non-Western meanings, advocating for community partnerships, participatory design, and relational ethics.

Discussion of the structural inequalities and neocolonial dynamics between the Global North and Global South in AI development, proposing technology transfer and data sovereignty for marginalized communities.
